name: MOT_TERR_DIM_MEM_FLAG_STAGING
description: Staging table used to store user initiated flagging changes that will impact large number of rows in the MOT_TERR_DIM_MEM_FLAGS table. The rows in this table will be consumed by an ESS job that will in-turn update the MOT_TERR_DIM_MEM_FLAGS table with the changes and then delete the contents once the updates are successful.

columns.name: TERR_DIM_MEM_FLAG_STAGING_ID
columns.description: Primary key of the staging table. Will be auto generated.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: Order in which the operation in this staging table should be processed in the Flagging table.

columns.name: DIMENSION_ID
columns.description: Dimension id for the member. This will help in grouping requests together so that all requests corresponding to one Dimension will be done in one job.

columns.name: PARTITION_ID
columns.description: Partition that the member belongs to. Will be the ID of the flagging partition.

columns.name: TERR_DIM_MEM_FLAG_ID
columns.description: Reference to the row in the Flagging table in which this operation was performed.

columns.name: EXPLICIT_FLAG
columns.description: E / I (based on the operation).

columns.name: ENABLE_UNSPEC_FLAG
columns.description: Y / N (based on the operation).

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Future use. In case there are multiple workers, identifies which rows are to be processed by which worker.

columns.name: UI_OPERATION
columns.description: Could be one of the operations that the user performs on the Tree Table.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_LOW
columns.description: Denormalized from the Dimension Member table.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_HIGH
columns.description: Denormalized from the Dimension Member table.

columns.name: LEVEL_NUMBER
columns.description: Denormalized from the Dimension Member table.

columns.name: LEAF_FLAG
columns.description: Denormalized from the Dimension Member table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
